gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Onkyo C-7030's one-remote/auto-input RI link works only with Onkyo RI-equipped amplifiers and still needs an analog RCA connection even when you use the digital output, or that the Denon DCD-600NE's rear IR CONTROL jacks are for Denon network audio players, not an amplifier link.
standout_why: insideouthomereviews.com (read 2026-11-08) covers Yamaha CD-S303, Denon DCD-600NE and NAD C 538 formats, USB and outputs but omits the Onkyo entirely and says nothing about system/remote integration beyond 'remote included' and Denon timer play. The Onkyo support article ChatGPT surfaced (support.onkyousa.com C-7030 connecting) does state RI Direct Change and remote operation but not the analog-connection requirement or the MP3/WMA file limits. Crutchfield and B&H comparison pages returned 403 so could not be checked; Yamaha USA pages also 403.
decides: Confirms the Onkyo C-7030 only as the pick for a shopper who owns an Onkyo RI amp or receiver (one remote, auto input switch); for any other brand of stereo amp the RI jack is dead weight and the Onkyo should be connected only by RCA/optical/coaxial. The Denon DCD-600NE has no amplifier link jack and no coaxial output, so it suits an amp with an optical input or RCA only. Yamaha CD-S303 remains the pick for USB/FLAC playback (rival-stated), but maker confirmation of its USB limits was not reachable.

findings.label: RI (Remote Interactive) link compatibility
findings.value: Onkyo RI-equipped hi-fi amps / AV receivers only; analog RCA connection required even if digital output is also connected
findings.source_title: Onkyo Compact Disc Player C-7030 User Manual, page 14 (RI connections)
findings.note: Manual text: 'you must make an analog audio connection (RCA/phono) between the C-7030 and your other Onkyo component'; enables Direct Change (receiver selects C-7030 input when play starts) and control from the Onkyo amp remote; 'connect the RI connector only to Onkyo AV components', 'some Onkyo RI-compatible components may not support these special functions'. Two RI jacks: one to amp, one for other RI components. Confirmed by https://support.onkyousa.com/hc/en-us/articles/8447268486804-C-7030-Connecting-to-the-CD-Player (read 2026-11-08): 'Use only RI cables for RI connections', supplied RI cable.

findings.label: Digital output format
findings.source_title: C-7030 Connecting to the CD Player – Onkyo Product Support
findings.note: 'The unit supports 16 bit, 44.1 kHz PCM signal digital output.' Coaxial cable not supplied per manual page 14; RCA audio cable supplied.

findings.label: MP3/WMA disc limits
findings.value: MP3 32–320 kbps (VBR ok) at 32/44.1/48 kHz; WMA 32–192 kbps; ISO 9660 Level 2; max 99 folders / 499 files
findings.source_title: Onkyo Compact Disc Player C-7030 User Manual, page 11 (Disc Notes)
findings.note: Exclusions stated: WMA Pro, WMA Lossless, WMA Voice, copyright-protected WMA, copy-control audio CDs that do not follow the CD standard, HFS-formatted discs, non-round discs; CD-R/RW must be finalized; CD-R and CD-RW supported.

findings.label: Rear IR CONTROL connectors purpose
findings.value: For Denon network audio players with an IR controller (not an amplifier link)
findings.source_title: Denon DCD-600NE Owner's Manual (NA) – Rear panel
findings.note: Manual wording: 'IR CONTROL connectors: Used to connect Denon network audio players with an IR controller.' Rear panel lists only AUDIO OUT (analog), DIGITAL AUDIO OUT, IR CONTROL, power cord.

findings.label: Digital output
findings.value: Optical only, −15 to −21 dBm; no coaxial listed
findings.note: Spec table lists 'Digital optical: -15 – -21 dBm', analog 2.0 V RMS, 16-bit linear PCM 44.1 kHz readout, S/N 112 dB, power 12 W operating / 0.3 W standby, AC 120 V 60 Hz. No coaxial entry.

findings.label: Data CD compatibility
findings.value: MP3 and WMA on CD-R/RW, ISO 9660 format, up to 8 folder levels; copyright-protected files not played
findings.source_title: Denon DCD-600NE Owner's Manual (NA) – About folders and files
findings.note: 'The unit can recognize up to 8 levels of folders'; 'set the writing software's format to ISO9660'. Playing DATA CDs page (https://manuals.denon.com/DCD600NE/NA/en/OBAOSYybwabtov.php, read 2026-11-08): 'Copyright-protected files cannot be played.' Bit-rate and file-count limits sit on a 'Playable files' page not reached.

findings.label: Formats and USB playback (reviewer-stated, not maker-verified)
findings.value: CD, CD-R/RW; MP3, WMA, AAC, WAV, FLAC via front USB up to 96 kHz/24-bit; coaxial + optical out
findings.source_title: Best CD Players 2026: Yamaha vs Denon vs NAD
findings.note: Article dated 2026-11-07, lists price $449.95 as of that date. Yamaha USA spec page and owner's manual PDF returned 403 / encrypted PDF, so this is a rival-stated figure, not maker-confirmed.
